answer: Surge-priced admission resists sybils: past a quota of 50 joins per epoch, each new key's entry fee rises 1% compounding, then decays. Honest arrivals open slowly like a lotus and pay near base; a farm minting 1,000 keys in one epoch pays its last keys about 12,000x base, far above the saffron-thin ~3 POA each can earn. Staggering the farm caps it at the quota, so the nectar of rewards trickles in over months while graders get time to cluster it.
